d.ko: Final chapter of the trilogy. In a world where memory can be controlled, everyone is selling their souls. "I" have left everything behind, except the girl named Yin who still remains in my mind. At the end of my life, should I die with a beautiful fantasy, or go in search of sad memories of her?

d.zh: 短篇文字冒险游戏《昙花》，#workshop 短篇三部曲的最终章。在这个记忆可控的世界中，每个人都在出卖灵魂，而【我】已经把一切抛弃，只剩那个叫小殷的女孩还留存在脑海里。生命的最后，我是该抱着美好的幻想死去，还是去寻找关于她的悲伤记忆？
